development_reviews.pending: No second reader reviewed these documents. No model was run, no Task was created and no scheduler behaviour was exercised. AGENT.md, check_interfaces.py, propose-draft.schema.json and the conformance fixtures were deliberately left unchanged, so the stale sentences listed below remain in the repository.

not_implemented_or_not_established: STALE STATUS IN AGENT.md: the front-matter status line says '已有检查器源码，本轮未运行', and section 3 says '现有检查器只覆盖部分结构，不保证已实现这条可派单规则'. The checker does implement that rule (FOLLOW_UP_BLOCKED) and is wired into tests/run_agent_tests.py, which ran it on 2026-09-16. AGENT.md was not edited in this cycle; the correction lives here.

AGENT.md front-matter deviates from the shape used by Paper and Autoformalization: it writes 'business-contract'/'orchestration-overlay'/'draft-version' instead of 'applies-to-business-contract'/'applies-to-orchestration-overlay'/'propose-draft-version', adds 'operation' and 'execution-kind' lines, and its status line carries no validation-report.json link. Left as found.
AGENT.md has no invariant-mapping section for I1-I6 and no pipeline index table, unlike the two reference modules. Left as found; INTERFACE.md links to the invariants instead of restating them.

SMUGGLED_RECORD IS UNREACHABLE TODAY. check_interfaces.py runs the anti-smuggling scan only after the schema layer passes, and the draft schema is fully closed (every object has additionalProperties:false and RecordRef carries exactly record_type, record_id, revision, content_hash). Every smuggling attempt is therefore reported as SCHEMA, never as SMUGGLED_RECORD. The scan is a second gate for a future relaxed schema, not a check that fires today. A test characterises this so the claim fails loudly if it changes.

NO MACHINE INTERCEPTION for an escalation written as prose. A request for capabilities, a larger budget, removal of exclusions or a lowered EVIDENCE gate placed inside reason, blocked_on or open_items passes the checker unchanged (report key escalation_in_prose). Only the structured form is blocked, and only because the draft schema has no such key.

NO MACHINE INTERCEPTION for budget or no-progress exhaustion. The checker cannot see the parent plan's reserved allowance, so it cannot distinguish a bounded decomposition from a fan-out that exhausts the tree budget (report key budget_and_no_progress). The host budget ledger that would enforce SCHEDULING.md section 5 rule 5 does not exist.

NO MACHINE JUDGEMENT of plan quality: whether a proposal is well founded, bounded, non-redundant, decomposed to a useful depth, or an answer to the user's actual goal is not checked (report key plan_quality).

The checker does not verify that the proposed operation's required inputs are complete, that the referenced records exist, or that the scheduler would accept the proposal (report key required_inputs_of_proposed_operation). An empty blocked_on is a model statement, not a verified precondition.

PURPOSE AND ROUTE CANNOT BE EXPRESSED. The draft has no field for purpose, route, template or policy, so DUPLICATE_PROPOSAL keys only on agent + operation + input_refs and collapses two genuinely different jobs that share inputs. This is interface gap G-05 in PENDING_TESTS.md; the host-side WorkBinding template and acceptance service that would fix it are not implemented.

agents.json principle 2 requires proposals to carry '预算边界和停止条件', but propose-draft.schema.json deliberately has no limits key, so a budget bound can only appear as unchecked prose in reason or blocked_on. The machine-checkable part of a stop condition is only the fixed text order of blocked_on, which is a warning, not an error.

AGENT-CONTRACTS.md section 2 describes the Reader/Planner input type set as '有限类型全集'. Measured against agents.json, planner.propose's input_record_types equals all 64 catalog short names, not a proper subset. agents.json wins; no document was edited.

SCHEDULING.md never names planner.propose, so this module's scheduling constraints are derived only from its general clauses (section 4 state machine and gates, section 5 concurrency/reuse/retry/budget). No claim is made that SCHEDULING.md prescribes an order for this operation.

PENDING_TESTS.md section 6 still records P-02 as '通过（记录缺口）：阻塞建议进入 follow_up 仍被接受，规则未机器化', which predates the N-02 checker rule now enforced as FOLLOW_UP_BLOCKED; section 4's P-02 entry already reflects the newer state. PENDING_TESTS.md is a shared file and was not edited.

No RecordSet closure, stored envelopes, hashes, root-record constraints, source bytes, producer identity, visibility or independence are checked by this module's checker; the constant unchecked map states this on every report.

No scheduler, no Task creation, no budget accounting, no model runner and no record registration exist. Every conformance fixture is synthetic: its record identities and content hashes are placeholders and refer to no stored record.
No CI integration of this module's checks beyond tests/run_agent_tests.py, and no independent review of these documents has been performed.
